profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Tel Aviv and traded under the ticker WIX, with CIK 0001576789. Its site presents it as a website builder: the company describes a free, easy-to-use builder offering more than 2,000 templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. It also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins.

On the AI side, the site's claims are limited to built-in AI tools within the builder and specialized AI agents meant to help keep a business growing. The material does not name specific AI products, and no litigation, MCP servers, or separately tracked products are recorded for the company.
